summary: The product's color faded and the seams started coming apart after just two washes.
The customer was disconnected after being on hold for forty minutes.
The customer received an item that was almost grey instead of the deep navy shown in the product photo.
The customer received a shipment with a crushed box and a cracked screen.
The customer received no response to three emails sent over a two-week period.
The product stopped working after four days of use and had to be returned.
The customer was unable to read the product instructions due to an unreadable language and a lack of diagrams.
The customer was charged twice for the same order.
The zipper jammed the very first time the product was used.
Order #48213 was cancelled without any notice.
The customer was charged an unmentioned $12.99 restocking fee.
